assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: a detailed low fidelity selected sketch for an Indonesian UX report. One complete vertically tall mobile-content view, visual proportions 390 x 844, portrait approximately 1:2.16. No device bezel, no phone outline, no operating system bars.
Primary request: Extend the accordion concept of reference Image 1 into a state where an authorized Owner's check result is available and sufficient for the SAME order. Keep its black / white / neutral gray palette, simple outlined rectangles, document/payment/search/followup line icons, accordion chevrons, clean printed Indonesian labels. Crisp low fidelity, not a polished app. Four accordion headers remain visible, and order identity remains at the top. Whitespace and text sizes approximately 20 px equivalent, avoid tiny labels.
Reference: Image 1 is visual reference for accordion spacing, line style, and icons. This is a NEW state for the same selected concept. Do not inherit its pending text.
Exact content and hierarchy from top to bottom:
- Simple text navigation row "< Kembali" on left, "Menu" on right.
- Main heading "Detail Pesanan".
- Persistent identity "PSN-015" then "Bank Transfer | Rp150.000".
- Accordion 1 collapsed header "Ringkasan Pesanan" with downward chevron and document icon.
- Accordion 2 compact header "Pembayaran" with payment icon. Small visible body "Pembayaran tercatat", "Belum memastikan dana masuk.", and a clear underlined text action "Lihat bukti BKT-015".
- Accordion 3 expanded header "Pemeriksaan" with search icon and upward chevron. Its body: bold "Hasil tersedia"; "Sumber: Owner"; "Hasil: HAS-015 untuk PSN-015". Then four READ ONLY short criterion lines, presented as plain text separated by subtle lines, NOT editable checkboxes: "Sumber berwenang"; "Data terbaru cocok"; "Nominal sesuai Rp150.000"; "Dana diterima menurut hasil Owner". The final line can wrap naturally.
- Accordion 4 expanded header "Tindak Lanjut" with followup icon and upward chevron. Its body "Dasar: HAS-015", a prominent dark outlined button "Simpan keputusan Teruskan", and a secondary outlined button "Tahan untuk klarifikasi". Wrap button label to two lines if necessary instead of tiny text.
- Footer small "Data ilustrasi".
Semantic constraints: This is an illustrative authorized result state, not bank API verification or Ari checking bank. Criteria summarize the Owner result and are read only, never manual checkmarks that certify receipt. No success message yet; the decision has not been saved. No timer/ETA, no send-new-request button. No physical handoff or cleaning started. Exactly one screen, no option numbers, no extra features, no blue/color. All content must fit legibly within the tall composition with comfortable padding.
assets.inspection: Read only adequacy lines, authorized Owner source, result HAS-015 tied to PSN-015, primary saves decision and secondary holds for clarification. All four accordion headers and identity visible; no saved success yet. Copy only.

assets.prompt:

Primary request: Draw the CONFIRMED SAVED DECISION state of the SAME accordion concept for order PSN-015 in Fleffy shoe laundry application. This screen is only displayed after saving the decision is confirmed successful. Black / white / neutral gray only, simple crisp outlined rectangles, line icons, accordion chevrons, printed Indonesian labels with comfortable spacing, font approximately 20 px equivalent. Low fidelity, no polished production graphics.
Input images: Image 1 is the original selected accordion concept; Image 2 is the result-review state of the same concept. Match their order identity, outlined section style, icons, navigation and clean white background. Produce a NEW saved state, not a copy of pending or unsaved content.
Exact content and hierarchy from top to bottom:
- Simple top navigation "< Kembali" on left, "Menu" on right.
- Heading "Detail Pesanan".
- Persistent identity "PSN-015", then "Bank Transfer | Rp150.000".
- Accordion 1 collapsed header "Ringkasan Pesanan" with document icon and downward chevron.
